427  static size_t
   428  H5O_attr_size(const H5F_t H5_ATTR_UNUSED *f, const void *_mesg)
   429  {
   430      const H5A_t         *attr = (const H5A_t *)_mesg;
   431      size_t              name_len;
   432      size_t              ret_value = 0;
   433
   434      FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI_NOINIT_NOERR
   435
   436      HDassert(attr);
   437
   438      /* Common size information */
   439      ret_value = 1 +                             /*version               */
   440                  1 +                             /*reserved/flags        */
   441                  2 +                             /*name size inc. null   */
   442                  2 +                             /*type size             */
   443                  2;                              /*space size            */
   444
   445      /* Length of attribute name */
   446      name_len = HDstrlen(attr->shared->name) + 1;
   447
   448      /* Version-specific size information */
   449      if(attr->shared->version == H5O_ATTR_VERSION_1)
   450          ret_value += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(name_len) +  /*attribute name        */
   451                      H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->dt_size) +      /*datatype              */
   452                      H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->ds_size) +      /*dataspace             */
   453                      attr->shared->data_size;            /*the data itself       */
   454      else if(attr->shared->version == H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2)
   455          ret_value += name_len   +               /*attribute name        */
   456                      attr->shared->dt_size +             /*datatype              */
   457                      attr->shared->ds_size +             /*dataspace             */
   458                      attr->shared->data_size;            /*the data itself       */
   459      else if(attr->shared->version == H5O_ATTR_VERSION_3)
   460          ret_value += 1 +                        /*character encoding    */
   461                      name_len    +               /*attribute name        */
   462                      attr->shared->dt_size +             /*datatype              */
   463                      attr->shared->ds_size +             /*dataspace             */
   464                      attr->shared->data_size;            /*the data itself       */
   465      else
   466          HDassert(0 && "Bad attribute version");
   467
   468      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   469  } /* end H5O_attr_size() */
